overview.description: The Columbia Research Enhanced Core Premium Income ETF (RECI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund replicates the holdings of an enhanced US equity index, comprised of US large- and mid-cap companies, while being actively managed. The fund also employs call option strategies in seeking high income and capital appreciation. RECI was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Columbia Threadneedle.
